tagline: Custom Landscape Design, Patios & Yard Grading in Appleton, WI
ownerStory: Based in Appleton and serving homeowners throughout the Fox Valley, Maple Leaf Landscaping & Design LLC crafts welcoming outdoor spaces built for Wisconsin seasons—from interlocking paver patios, pergolas, and stone retaining walls to crisp mulch beds, hardy plantings, and clean lawn grading.

services.name: Paver Patios, Pergolas & Retaining Walls
services.desc: Custom-designed interlocking paver patios, curved stone seating walls, fire pit zones, and timber pergolas built on deeply compacted aggregate bases for lasting Appleton outdoor living.

services.name: Landscape Design, Beds & Planting
services.desc: Freshly edged foundation beds, dark hardwood mulch, ornamental shrubs, hostas, and Zone 4-5 perennials arranged for multi-season color and clean curb appeal across the Fox Valley.

services.name: Finish Grading, Sod & Property Cleanups
services.desc: Precision slope grading to direct water away from foundations, fresh sod installation, decorative stonework, and thorough spring and fall cleanups across Appleton neighborhoods.
